text: Drake Maye delivered his best performance of the season in Sunday's dominant 45-17 victory over the Raiders at Gillette Stadium, accounting for five total touchdowns while working without his top receiver and operating behind a depleted offensive line, and the film review suggests he's finally found both his confidence and his deep ball after a rocky start to the year. The win came at a cost, however, as the Patriots lost RB TreVeyon Henderson to an ankle injury and LT Will Campbell to what sources indicate is a knee sprain, adding to New England's growing injury woes heading into Coach Mike Vrabel's postgame presser. Despite missing both starting cornerbacks and multiple other starters, the Patriots' defense was equally impressive in the blowout, contributing eight takeaways worth examining on tape as the team proved it can still dominate when the pieces fall into place. The victory showcased a Patriots team finding its footing at the right time, even as the injury report threatens to complicate their path forward.
